steps.content: One night in the Bureau's corridors, MBCC
After a long day, you walk down the hallway back to your office. You let out a long sigh as you flip through a new schedule you just received.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Great, another week without weekends. Why do these tedious meetings always have to be scheduled during off hours...

Suddenly, a loud crash echoes from the end of the corridor, and the lighting system instantly fails. Emergency red lights on the walls flash incessantly, and the Bureau's alarm system immediately blares to life.

steps.speaker: Announcement
steps.content: Warning! Warning! Attack from an abnormal source detected in the Bureau's underground area! Relevant department personnel, proceed to the area immediately!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well... here we go again...
Just then, a familiar figure grows larger in your field of vision, stumbling and panicking as they frantically rush toward you.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief! Help me, something terrible has happened!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What did you do this time?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: No, no! This time it really isn't my fault! Eek—!
Before the words leave her lips, an electric arrow grazes over both your heads and strikes the flashing warning light with pinpoint accuracy.
The attacker's burly, rotund silhouette emerges from the darkness, gradually approaching you. In the chaos, you notice that it just used EMP's ability.

steps.speaker: Sovereign Duck
steps.content: Quack quack quack quack, quack, quack quack quack quack... (The one-year term is up... I am no longer who I once was...)

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What happened?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I-I-I don't know either! I just saw the ducks looking a bit down after finishing their work in the Depot, so I shared a novel I'd just bought with them. I had no idea they'd turn out like this after reading it!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: It even copied my Syndicate the Grim Reaper ultimate technique... Chief, you don't think that novel could actually be some kind of martial arts manual, do you? I didn't even have the chance to read it myself!

steps.speaker: Sovereign Duck
steps.content: Quack! Quack quack quack quack! (Today! I will reclaim everything that belongs to me!)

Strange cards flutter around the duck, and with each one it throws, it unleashes a Sinner's ability—blazing flames, ice crystals, butterflies, and mushrooms appearing one after another in endless succession.
The confrontation reaches a temporary stalemate. If the duck gains the upper hand before reinforcements arrive, the Bureau's operations could be disrupted for days to come.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The duck clearly came prepared. The two of us probably can't hold it off!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh? Really? I feel like I can still give it a little more effort...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll hold it off by myself. EMP, you go find Nightingale first. Once we've restricted its range of movement, we can take our time and carefully plan our counterattack.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: What are you talking about, Chief! I won't just ditch you like that. I can still fight. If you still insist on making me leave...

Her voice sounds like it's coming from somewhere far behind you. When you look back, EMP, who was fighting alongside you just moments ago, has already sprinted dozens of meters away without looking back.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I'm going, Chief! Just hang in there—I'll bring help and come back for you!

After sending EMP away, you turn to face Sovereign Duck once more. Accompanied by the sounds of cards brushing against each other, it pulls out another thick stack of cards and flashes you a crooked smile.

steps.speaker: Sovereign Duck
steps.content: Quack, quack quack quack quack? Quack quack, quack quack quack quack. (Heh, playing hard to get? Foul humans, you shall not escape!)
